A '''''Deathstalker''-class fighter''' was a heavily armed, fast, and maneuverable craft originated within the armies of the Despot Queen [[Hadiya]]. Like the [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii]] [[Hunter-class starfighter|''Hunter''-class starfighter]], a ''Deathstalker'' could fly in both open space and in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] conditions. The outcome of a fight between a ''Deathstalker'' and a ''Hunter'' depended on the skill of the pilots.
